implementation.targetScope: Import-time WSL boolean from Linux version strings and custom-kernel markers, excluding Podman/Docker through the VPM-only container closure. Includes the installed CommonJS caller interface.

differences: Current custom-kernel marker checks and Podman exclusion deliberately extend the app's is-wsl 2.2.0 behavior.
vis-docker 4.0.0 also excludes mountinfo-only Docker containers missed by the upstream Docker 3 closure.
CommonJS exports the primitive boolean directly; ESM shares that snapshot. The upstream private __IS_WSL_TEST__ function hook is retained, outside public declarations.
No command launch, environment mutation, native WSL verification, public release or application adoption is claimed.
